# Fuel Prices PK

> Today's petrol, diesel (HSD) and LPG prices in Pakistan — Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and more. Compare PSO, Shell and APL, track OGRA updates, find nearby pumps, and estimate trip cost.

## Product
Fuel Prices PK shows live Pakistan petrol, diesel (HSD) and LPG prices by city, OMC compare, history charts, nearby pumps, and trip cost calculators. Full URL list: https://oilprice.topgradesoftware.com/sitemap.xml
